test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 16 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

t n _ p z _ _ _ d p _ q _ n _ p z q

options.text: d q t q z t n
d q t n z t z
d z t n z t n
d q t n z t d

solution:
Given: t n _ p z _ _ _ d p _ q _ n _ p z q

 
• d q t q z t n → t n **d** p z **q -** **t** **q** d p **z** q - **t** n **n** p z q
 
• d q t n z t z → t n d p z q - t **n** d p z q - t n **z** p z q
 
• d z t n z t n → t n d p z **z** - t **n** d p z q - t n n p z q
 
• d q t n z t d → t n d p z q - t **n** d p z q - t n **d** p z q

 
• Option (4) is followed the cycle of **"tndpzq"**

Hence, the correct answer is **"d q t n z t d".**
